learning_outcomes.text: The bachelor assists in developing, testing, and trying out measurement systems.
The bachelor is able to compile technical dossiers regarding measurement technology.
The bachelor can manage measurement-technical aspects of a production process, such as controls, adjustments, configurations, and monitoring of the quality requirements of a production system.
The bachelor can keep measurement systems operational and follow up and solve maintenance problems.
The bachelor can provide advice on the purchase and sale of technological measurement systems and products.

syllabus_topics: Industrial environment setup: process, control room, low- and high-voltage room
Cabling and adjustment of various pressure, temperature, level, and flow measurements
Cabling and adjustment of various measurement circuits: Sensor - transmitter – readout
Cabling and adjustment of various measurement circuits: Sensor - transmitter - galvanic isolation – readout
Connecting proximity switches and (level) detectors with different connection properties to a PLC
Selecting and/or calculating devices to realize a specified measurement circuit
assessment_rules: For the first examination opportunity in January, the 'Measurement Technology & Sensors theory' is assessed by a 100% written exam. The 'Measurement Technology & Sensors lab' is assessed by continuous evaluation and a written exam. For the second examination opportunity in August, 'Measurement Technology & Sensors theory' is a 100% written exam, and 'Measurement Technology & Sensors lab' is a 100% practical exam. Partial transfers are possible for successful sub-results (YT5572 and YT5573) within the academic year.
